skills.name: blocker-note
skills.description: Use when debugging stalls (2+ failures, 20-30 min no progress, or looping) — persist attempts, evidence, and ruled-out causes to docs/notes/blocker-<topic>.md, then stop.

skills.name: bugfix-debug-loop
skills.description: Use when fixing a reported bug in existing behavior — reproduce first, minimal fix, max 2 hypotheses.

skills.name: docs-sync-loop
skills.description: Use when docs have drifted from already-shipped code — apply the DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md update map with pointers, not duplicates.

skills.name: feature-slice-builder
skills.description: Use when implementing one user-visible feature from docs/TASKS.md that spans data and UI (mock-first, connected-read, core-auth, connected-write, recovery, or protected deletion).

skills.name: interactive-preview-loop
skills.description: Use when a task requires evidence-backed interactive verification of an Expo user journey in iOS Simulator or the project reference mobile-web viewport, or a screenshot-based UX audit with numbered captures and triaged findings — not for automated project checks, UI implementation, or bug fixing.

skills.name: pr-human-review
skills.description: Use when an implementation-complete pull request needs human acceptance — explain the change without line-by-line review, split product and behavior decisions from automated verification, and recommend whether it is ready.

skills.name: pr-review-remediation
skills.description: Use when an existing pull request already has reviewer findings that need current-head triage, root-cause deduplication, and one explicitly authorized remediation pass; not for first-pass review, standalone bugs, human acceptance, or checks-only work.

skills.name: product-data-modeling
skills.description: Use for frontend-only product/rating shape changes — types, mock data, and API contracts, with no SQL.

skills.name: refactor-safety-loop
skills.description: Use when restructuring code with zero behavior change — declared non-goals, allowed-files list, before/after checks.

skills.name: session-handoff
skills.description: Use at a session boundary (phase done, topic switch, overloaded context) — write docs/notes/handoff.md and recommend a fresh session.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Use when turning a repeated (3+) or human-directed reviewed workflow into a new SKILL.md, tuning a skill's trigger description, or iterating/maintaining existing skills.

skills.name: supabase-schema-change
skills.description: Use for schema, migration, RLS, grant, database function or trigger, rating-summary, or other database-backed contract changes; not seed-only data.

skills.name: test-and-validation-loop
skills.description: Use when running project checks for a finished change — narrowest command first, fix only caused-by-change failures, max 2 retries.

skills.name: ui-screen-builder
skills.description: Use when building or redesigning one Expo / React Native screen's UI following docs/DESIGN.md.
